title: Fade out when closing
line: The Application Dashboard now fades out when it closes instead of vanishing at once.
explanation: The Application Dashboard is a fullscreen plasmashell window, and KWin's open/close effects deliberately skip undecorated plasmashell windows, so nothing animated it: closing it (Escape, launching an app, clicking away, the shortcut) hid the window in a single frame. The change adds a fade-out of the dashboard's contents over Kirigami.Units.longDuration before the window is closed, and routes every close path (interaction finished, panel icon, global shortcut) through it. Toggling again during the fade cancels it and keeps the dashboard open; with animations disabled it closes instantly as before.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: fade out the Application Dashboard when closing it

The dashboard disappeared in a single frame when it was closed, which
felt abrupt next to the rest of Plasma. Now its contents fade out over
the standard animation duration before the window is hidden.

BUG: 454717

media.caption: Pure master, slowed 4x: pressing Escape makes the dashboard vanish in one frame.
With the fix, slowed 4x: the dashboard fades out before it closes.
Three consecutive frames at the close on master: full dashboard, full dashboard, desktop.
Consecutive frames at the close with the fix: the contents fade over ~200 ms, then the window hides.
